# verygood chocolate Sydney

> Chocolate cakes made with chocolatier-grade couverture chocolate for birthdays, parties and gifting. Cake pick-up · Fri 18:00–20:00 · Sat–Sun 08:00–20:00

Official AU website: https://au.verygood-chocolate.com
Primary service area: Melrose Park, Sydney
Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/verygood_syd/

## Ordering
- Choose a cake and options.
- Send a request so availability can be checked.
- Receive payment details after availability is confirmed.
- Collect in Melrose Park after final confirmation · Fri 18:00–20:00 · Sat–Sun 08:00–20:00.

## Cakes
- Pave Chocolate Cake: A rich four-layer chocolate cake built for a dense, chocolate-forward bite. Instead of a light sponge-and-cream style, each layer is filled with smooth pave chocolate ganache, creating a substantial cake with deep chocolate flavour from the first slice to the last. From AUD 79.00. 6 inch serves approximately 8–10, 8 inch serves approximately 14–18, and 10 inch serves approximately 24–28. Choose a size · dark chocolate only https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/pave-chocolate-cake
- Buttercream Cake: Our Signature Gâteau au Chocolat layers are filled and finished with chocolate buttercream made with Italian meringue, real butter and cocoa powder. From AUD 75.00. 6 inch serves approximately 8–10, 8 inch serves approximately 14–18, and 10 inch serves approximately 24–28. Choose a size and cake colour · Chocolate Buttercream included https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/buttercream-cake
- Fresh Strawberry Vanilla Cream Cake: Soft genoise layers filled with vanilla fresh cream and fresh strawberries, finished with more strawberries on top. Real vanilla bean brings a fragrant finish to the fresh cream. From AUD 65.00. 6 inch serves approximately 6–8, 8 inch serves approximately 10–14, and 10 inch serves approximately 16–20. Choose a size https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/fresh-strawberry-vanilla-cream-cake
- Fresh Strawberry Chocolate Cream Cake: Soft genoise layers filled with chocolate fresh cream and fresh strawberries, finished with more strawberries on top. A classic chocolate-and-strawberry combination in a fresh-cream cake. From AUD 69.00. 6 inch serves approximately 6–8, 8 inch serves approximately 10–14, and 10 inch serves approximately 16–20. Choose a size https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/fresh-strawberry-chocolate-cream-cake
- Chocolate Cupcakes: Chocolate cupcakes for sharing, parties and easy gifting. Choose a half dozen or dozen, then select one finish for the whole box. From AUD 31.00. Choose a half dozen or dozen, then select Basic, Vanilla Fresh Cream, or Chocolate Buttercream. Choose a pack size and one finish for the whole box https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/chocolate-cupcakes
- Signature Gâteau au Chocolat: A rich rectangular gâteau au chocolat finished with dark chocolate. Simple, compact and easy to share or gift. AUD 45.00. Choose Basic finish, Extra chocolate +AUD 7.00, or Vanilla cream +AUD 10.00. Choose one finish option https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/signature-gateau-au-chocolat
- Lemon Cake: Made with freshly squeezed lemon juice and fresh lemon zest, from the cake batter to the lemon syrup and glaze. A bright, citrus-forward little cake finished with real lemon flavour in every step. From AUD 36.00. Boxes of 6, 8, 12 or 16. Choose a pack size and finishing mix. The 12-piece box is Most Popular. https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/lemon-cake
- Brownie Cheesecake: A rich dark chocolate brownie base topped with a baked Basque-style cheesecake layer. Two contrasting textures come together in one chocolate-and-cheesecake dessert. Basic AUD 85.00, Pave AUD 95.00 (+AUD 10.00), or Fresh cream AUD 105.00 (+AUD 20.00). 6 inch serves 8 · three mutually exclusive finish choices https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/brownie-cheesecake

## Kids cake classes
- Three limited Saturday cake class dates in Melrose Park, Sydney: 26 September, 3 and 10 October 2026, with sessions at 10:00, 13:00 and 16:00. Basic welcomes children from Kindy to Year 6; Advanced starts from Year 2.
- Base course/package prices: AUD 99.00–254.60.
- A Basic + Advanced package covers two separate Spring Vacation sessions and receives 5% off the base class fees.
- A 30-minute extension is AUD 20.00 per participant, per class and is not discounted.
- https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/classes
